summary:
# NOTES: *Adele Doring of the Sunnyside Club* (Grace May North, 1919, Lothrop, Lee & Shepard; illustrated by Florence Liley Young)

Single book, 33 chapters. Dedicated to Margaret Edna Rock and happy-hearted girls 10–15.

## Cast
- **Adele Doring**: leader/president, 13 on her birthday, golden-brown braids, rides black pony **Firefly**; calls father "Giant Father"/"Daddy", mother "Mumsie"/"Adorable Mother"; brother **Jack** (1 yr older, indolent, "Pirate the Terrible" in Jolly Pirates club); cook **Kate** (Irish, "Colleen"); handyman **Terrence**; white Persian cat **Fluff**; uncle **Dixon** (traveler); uncle **Jerry** (abroad).
- **Sunny Seven / Sunny Six**: Adele; **Rosamond "Rosie" Wright** (romantic, dislikes scrubbing, tatting, fears ghosts); **Doris Drexel** (father bank president; grandmother's pillow/prints); **Bertha Angel** (practical, treasurer, father grocer; brother **Bob Angel**, teases her); **Peggy Pierce** (father Mr. Pierce owns Bee Hive department store; brother with silver whistle); **Betty Burd** (youngest, 11→12, petite, dark, widowed mother Mrs. Burd, uncle **George Wainwright** editor, calls her "Betsy Bobbets"; pony later named **Star**); **Gertrude Willis** (secretary, minister's daughter, father Mr. Willis; wants to be writer).
- **Eva Dearman**: orphan, 13 on birthday, golden hair, blue eyes; father wealthy broker, died; mother died; Mrs. Friend's orphanage; uncle **Richard "Dick" Dearman**, Cattle King of Silver Creek, Bar-X Ranch, Arizona; father's letters returned "Dry Creek, Arizona."; father's satchel; mother's photograph.
- **Amanda Brown**: surly orphan, 13, black braids, crimson bows; mother singer who died; later sings with professor; blue ring from Eva.
- **Mrs. Friend**: orphanage matron. Other orphans: Jenny Dixon, Mabel Hicks, Sadie Bell, Jenny Waine, Sally West.
- **Miss Donovan**: Seven B teacher. **Mr. Dickerson**: principal (father of five).
- **Madge Peterson**: artist, 18, from city; brother **Everett Peterson** (North High; sails, swims); car "Pigmy" (olive-green); lives in Dorchester; patron of art classes at Art Institute; Miss Fenton teacher.
- **Eric Brownley** ("Kid"), foster-son of **Jock Henderson**; pet bear **Little Bear** (died); horse **Lightning**; pitcher; "Petey" is Everett's nickname.
- **Roberty-Bob**: hunchbacked boy in tenement, goldfish, kitten Muffin; mother works factory.
- **Miss Sally Grackle** (sister of **Miranda** who eloped to Arizona); cabin house by woods; later "Sally"; **Granny Dorset** (Sarie Dorset, turns 70); **Mr. & Mrs. Quigley** (Dan/Pa and Betsy/Ma) from poorhouse; **Grandpa 'Lijah Dally** (son of sheep-herder; wolf story), daughter with baby.
- **Mr. & Mrs. Cyrus Green** (Restwell estate; former tavern keeper, Western); **Mrs. Melissa Green** (Melissy, snobbish); daughter **Susetta** (formerly Susie Green). Maid Melissy at Burd house.
- Mrs. Doring, Mr. Doring (Giant Father; bought cabin), Mrs. Drexel, Mrs. Burd, Mrs. Willis, Mr. Drakely (postman), Mr. Wiggin, Lawrence Collins, Dick Jensen, Dorset, Ching Ling (Chinese cook at inn), Mr. Pierce, Mr. Drexel (bank president), Miss Meadly (seamstress), Miss Kimberly (children's poet), Dora Pendleton.

## Places
Sunnyside (suburban town, Little Bear Lake nearby, Lookout Hill, Buttercup Meadows, maple wood, laughing brook); the **Secret Sanctum** (log cabin, sheep-herders', Adele's father's property; rustic furniture, china-closet of orange boxes, mosquito netting, pine pillow); elm-tree in school-yard; Orphans' Home on Lake Road (a mile out); Little Bear Inn (Pine Island, Lake); Cherry Lane; Dickerson Road; poorhouse 2 miles east road; Dorchester (city, 10 miles); North High vs South High ball game; Restwell estate on Lake Road.

## Chronology (key events)
1. April: seven girls form Sunnyside Club on elm-tree meadow. Adele president; Gertrude secretary; Bertha treasurer. Pledge rhyme. Log cabin obtained.
2. Scrubbing-party Saturday; Bertha director; olives; furniture; ideas (mosquito netting, china-closet).
3. Adele announces birthday (13) and Eva Dearman's surprise party (Eva's birthday same day). Bank stolen-by-move; Peggy had taken bank to father's safe. Bought 12 locket necklaces at Bee Hive for $6.33 (Peggy's father lowered cost).
4. Surprise party: hay-rack with Bob and Jack disguised as black waiters ("Rastus"); lockets; birthday cake with 13 pink roses.
5. Adele's evening surprise party at home (lights out, victrola); gifts: blue books "Stories That Girls Like Best" from Sunny Six; fern from Jolly Pirates; bird's-eye-maple desk from Giant Father; painting of cabin from Mother; cake fortunes (Rosie's ring).
6. Mother Goose play-house for orphan toddlers (Betty's gift of Mother Goose cloths from attic).
7. June exams; Betty's uncle George's bet (pony if perfect spelling); Betty passes; named pony Star.
8. Vacation: Eva invited for weekend; dryads on hill; meet Madge Peterson; Pine Island picnic; treasure-hunter "miser" revealed as Sunny boys in pirate costume (Pirate the Terrible crew; "Ben Gunn" = wild man). Fudge party with ghost scare (white tree-trunk whitewashed by Mr. Wiggin).
9. Fisherman Jock Henderson tells Little Bear story (rescue from bear, Eric adopted; uncle from city; Eric goes to school).
10. Eric's horse ride; fish supper; Uncle George gives ride; Madge's illustrating job.
11. Madge invites Eva to Art Institute; Amanda birthday; ride to city; Amanda's mother's singing story; singing master.
12. Ball game: North High vs South High; Eric arrives late from Little Bear shack.
13. Gertrude's composition "The King's Highway" (Alicia story) wins; Roberty-Bob.
14. School resumes; Miss Donovan returns as teacher. Granny Dorset surprise party planned; purple silk dress with lace.
15. Visits: Miss Grackle (ill, Adele brings lamb broth), Mrs. Quigley ("wear clouds with linings outside"), Grandpa Dally (miser story: Josh Perkins saw man counting gold).
16. Chipmunk knocks gold piece from boarded-up fireplace in Secret Sanctum; bag of gold ($1,000) with note ("wasn't come by honest"); deposited in bank; Quigleys given cottage.
17. Party at Miss Grackle's cottage: purple silk dress; Grandpa Dally's wolf story; Quigleys live in cottage.
18. New pupil Susetta Green; Mrs. Green's invitation refused by Sunny Seven; Mrs. Green chooses Eva as servant-companion ("slender one with yellow hair") at Restwell.
19. Eva humiliated (black dress, cap and apron; "servants' friends go to the side-door"). Mrs. Doring wants to adopt Eva.
20. Uncle Dick Dearman arrives; Susetta refuses to lie; Eva reunited; leaves with Uncle Dick and Amanda for Bar-X Ranch; Jack drives them to station (Douglas). Final line of book: invitation to "Adele Doring on a Ranch."

## Quoted phrases to remember
- "Suppose we have a club." (frontispiece)
- Pledge: "We promise to look on the Sunnyside / And be kind and cheerful each day..."
- "Heart's Desire" and "Giant Father" (Adele's pet names with father)
- "Sunny Seven" / "Sunny Six"
- "Stories That Girls Like Best"
- "hitch your wagon to a star" (Miss Donovan)
- "Fifteen men on a dead man's chest. Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum."
- "Every cloud has a silver lining; let's wear our clouds with the linings on the outside."
